# Janus

> Hybrid Web + Native UI from a single component source.

Use `@janus/primitives` (`H1`, `P`, `Div`, `Button`, …). Never write raw HTML or raw React Native primitives. Compose single-purpose layers. Platform APIs live in `*.ios.tsx` / `*.android.tsx` / `*.native.tsx` / `*.web.tsx`. Axe (web) or RNTL a11y tests ship with every layer.

- Mapping: packages/core/src/mapping.json
- Registry: packages/ui/src/registry.json
- Rules: .cursor/rules/
- Skills: .cursor/skills/ (janus-migrate for converting existing React apps)
- CLI: `janus migrate --dry-run` then `--write`. Do not hand-rename HTML tags.
- Full text: /llms-full.txt
